message: しあわせの味

name: Sacchin
message: 「Zzz... zzz...」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Mnya... I can't eat another bite~ ...My dessert stomach's gonna burst~」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's classic sleep-talking」

name: Synn
message: 「Sacchin, Sacchin」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Umyu~. Kashiwamochi~?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oh~, it's Synn-kun~」

name: Synn
message: 「Morning」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Wait, was I sleeping~?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sound asleep」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Mmm~. It's the central heating's fault~. Ahaha~」

name: Paqy
message: 「About 5% of it, yeah」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Huh~. Nana-chan isn't with you~?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. When I said I was stopping by the classroom to grab my dictionary, she said she'd head home first」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's rare~. For her to go home first and leave Synn-kun behind~」

name: Synn
message: 「Now that you mention it...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Synn-kun probably doesn't know~, but to put it bluntly, Nana-chan got a boyfriend~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Right about now, they're probably gorging on sweets at the shopping district~. All lovey-dovey~」

name: Synn
message: 「No way」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Curious~?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka is a girl, after all... and she's at the age where she'd be interested in that stuff」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yeah, yeah. That's a good sign」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah, right. Nanaka is cute, so if anything, it's weird it took this long for a guy to notice her charm」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I see~ So Synn-kun thinks Nana-chan is cute~」
Huh?
Just now, did I... call Nanaka cute...

name: Sacchin
message: 「Buuut, Nana-chan's got that losing heroine trait~」

name: Synn
message: 「Losing heroine trait?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well said」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Because Nana-chan always runs away from the fight right when it matters most~」

name: Synn
message: 「Really?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I think Synn-kun knows that better than anyone, though~」
Even though we're childhood friends, nothing came to mind at all.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oh, right~ I bet Nana-chan went over there~」

name: Synn
message: 「Where?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Don't go barging in on their date and beating the guy up, okay~?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not planning on getting in the way or anything. I'm just gonna size the guy up with the eyes of a protective father」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hmm-hmm~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Geez~ You two are such a handful~」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ahaha~ It's nothing~」
Doing just as Sacchin told me, I head toward Peace Tanimura Patisserie.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, it's Synn. What's up?」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh, ah, no, I was just passing by」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmm. Well, whatever」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, right. Wanna eat a little before you go?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You know the previous owner's flavors too, Synn, so」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you sure about this, though?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If you're worried about money, don't be. It's just a tasting.」
Doesn't really feel like she's out with a boyfriend...
Then again, Nanaka's always been super casual, so maybe this is just how she acts.

name: Paqy
message: 「I can't pass up a chance to pack in some calories!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Are you guys really that desperate?」
Could it be that Nanaka's boyfriend is actually inside the shop!?

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, I guess I'll take you up on that.」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「Welcome.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Give him a sample too, please. Synn knows how the previous owner's tasted, too.」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「Understood.」
Aside from Nanaka and me, there's nobody else in the shop.
Which means... this guy is her boyfriend...?
No way. Though. No. Still.

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's wrong? You've been acting weird for a while now.」

name: Synn
message: 「Have... I?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Relax. Eating it won't kill you.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not what I'm worried about.」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「Here you go. I'm still nowhere near my father's level, but please, enjoy.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, thank you.」
A familiar-looking eclair
It looks just like the one I ate with Nanaka a long, long time ago.
An eclair stuffed so full of whipped cream it looks ready to burst at any second
Inside the whipped cream, chunks of chocolate are packed in tight.
It's sloppy and rough around the edges at first glance.
Yet the one preserved in my memory was delicious beyond comparison.

name: Synn
message: 「It's good...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You'll yell 'It's good!' at literally anything as long as it's sweet.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... but...」
It's completely different from the old one. Like a whole other pastry.

name: Synn
message: 「The old one was... just as sweet and rich, but... how do I put it, the cream melted right in your mouth... or maybe the texture was smoother...」

name: Synn
message: 「The aftertaste, too... it wasn't heavy or sticky... rich, yet somehow refreshing...」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「The appearance has gotten pretty close, though... still a long way to go. Even she gave it 31 points」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, she said it's gotten tastier than at Kirafes」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... are the ingredients and everything the same?」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「I've kept them the same as far as what I could find out and get my hands on, anyway」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even if they're the same, when the maker gets older or a successor takes over, the result ends up changing」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that how it works...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Something seemed off with the cream, so when I looked into the farm, turns out they'd switched to compound feed. Changed the flavor, too」

name: Synn
message: 「It's subtle, huh」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「I'll just have to rely on my palate and keep trying different things. Thanks for today」

name: Synn
message: 「Not at all. All I did was eat」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「No, your feedback was valuable. Come by again whenever you feel like it」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, thank you.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, listen」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「What is it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I know I'm one to talk after tearing it apart however I pleased, but doesn't it bother you getting picked apart like that? Doesn't it make you hate baking?」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「Honestly, I do wish I'd get praised once in a while」

name: Synn
message: 「I bet」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「Still, that's just where my skill is at right now」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「No matter what they say, I'm grateful to anyone who eats my food. That's the truth」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「Besides, if I don't bake it first, nobody can even eat it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I see... yeah, you're right」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「Thank you very much! We look forward to your next visit」

name: Nanaka
message: 「First, if I don't make it, he won't be able to eat it, huh...」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, your phone」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What? Synn? Sure, I don't mind」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Here, Sacchin says she wants to talk to you」

name: Synn
message: 「What could it be? Hello」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Sooorry. That thing about Nana-chan getting a boyfriend was a liiie」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that how it waaas」
I had been beside myself with worry. In that case, that means Nanaka was simply going there to learn how to make delicious eclairs!
The taste of the eclair we ate together...

name: Sacchin
message: 「I thought it might be fuuun if a misunderstanding turned into a whole dramatic scene」

name: Synn
message: 「You're the only one who'd find that fun!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well, I don't need the bitter melon candy anymore, I changed my miiind」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Synn-kuuun, you went to the shopping district because I asked you to buy bitter melon candy, okaay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you ask me?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's the story we're going wiiith. Got iiit?」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't really get it, but alright」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Now, put Nana-chan back on」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Here」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What were you talking about? Bitter melon candy? What's that? Hmm. Oh well. Anyway, talk to you later」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Where do they even sell bitter melon candy?」

name: Synn
message: 「No... I don't know」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She asked you to get it, didn't she?」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, well, you know, it's Sacchin after all」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well... fair enough」
Seems like she's convinced. Is it really okay to treat my best friend like that?

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, bitter melon candy, huh? You really will eat anything...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Maybe its taste buds are right on par with yours, thinking anything sweet is delicious.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's harsh.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Toward which one of us?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, though. Even you can tell when something's genuinely delicious, right, Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「Pretty much anything sweet tastes good to me, though.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even sugar cubes.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The sweets from that old shop back then were really delicious, weren't they?」
The taste of those eclairs vividly comes back to me.

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You were eating them like they were the best thing ever.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Your cheeks are softening.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, really?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yep.」

name: Synn
message: 「Can't help it--they really were that good.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「True. You looked super happy.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I still remember that happy look on your face like it was yesterday.」
